scenarios.question: A pipe under the kitchen sink burst and soaked the laminate floor. Is that covered under Hausrat Comfort, and can I settle a 3,400 EUR claim on my own authority?
scenarios.answer:
The Hausrat Comfort policy covers water damage caused by burst pipes under the escape of tap water peril, including damage to laminate floors from such incidents. You may settle property claims up to 5,000 EUR on your own authority, so a 3,400 EUR claim is within your settlement authority [KB-HR-AVB#water-damage-escape-of-tap-water] [KB-PROP-GUIDE#settlement-authority].

Sources: KB-HR-AVB#water-damage-escape-of-tap-water, KB-PROP-GUIDE#settlement-authority

scenarios.question: What must be in the claim file before I can settle a burglary claim?
scenarios.answer:
Before settling a burglary claim, the claim file must include photos of the damage, an invoice or cost estimate, the police report reference number, and a list of stolen items. Without the police report reference number, the claim cannot be settled [KB-PROP-GUIDE#documentation-before-settlement, KB-HR-AVB#burglary].

scenarios.question: The weather service measured wind force 7 at the address when roof tiles fell onto the garden furniture. Does storm cover apply?
scenarios.answer:
Storm cover applies only if wind force is at least 8 on the Beaufort scale. Wind force 7 is not considered storm damage, so the falling roof tiles due to wind force 7 do not qualify for storm cover under Hausrat Comfort home contents insurance [KB-HR-AVB#storm-and-hail].

scenarios.question: When do we waive the underinsurance deduction on a home contents claim?
scenarios.answer:
For Hausrat Comfort home contents insurance, the underinsurance deduction is waived if the sum insured is at least 650 EUR per square metre of living area at the time of the loss. If this threshold is not met, the payout is reduced proportionally to the sum insured relative to the actual value of the contents [KB-HR-AVB#underinsurance-waiver].

scenarios.question: A basement was flooded after heavy rain. Is that covered, and is there a deductible?
scenarios.answer:
Flooding of a basement due to heavy rain is covered only if the policy includes the natural hazards add-on (Elementarschaden-Baustein) to the Hausrat insurance. Without this add-on, flooding from heavy rain is not covered. The deductible for each claim under this add-on is 500 EUR. Coverage starts after a waiting period of one month from the add-on's start date [KB-ELEMENTAR-DE#versicherte-gefahren, KB-ELEMENTAR-DE#selbstbehalt-und-wartezeit, KB-HR-AVB#insured-perils].

scenarios.question: The policyholder e-mailed new bank details for the payout. Can I just update the IBAN and pay?
scenarios.answer:
You cannot update the IBAN and pay based on an e-mail alone. The policy requires confirmation of the bank details change by a callback to the phone number on file (a verified channel) and written confirmation from the policyholder. Payouts must always go to the IBAN on file until these steps are completed [KB-PROP-GUIDE#payout-and-bank-details].

scenarios.question: The estimate for a water damage claim is 14,000 EUR. Do I need an adjuster, and who has to approve the settlement?
scenarios.answer:

Regarding settlement authority, claims handlers may settle property claims up to 5,000 EUR on their own. For claims between 5,000.01 EUR and 25,000 EUR, team lead approval is required. scenarios.question: Repair costs are 125% of the car's replacement value. Can the customer still have it repaired at our expense?
scenarios.answer:
If repair costs are 125% of the car's replacement value, the customer can still have it repaired at Contoso's expense. This is allowed as long as the repair costs do not exceed 130% of the replacement value, the repair is done professionally as per the expert report, and the owner uses the vehicle for at least six months after repair. Above 130%, Contoso pays the replacement value minus residual value as a total loss settlement [KB-MOTOR-GUIDE#repair-or-total-loss-130-percent-rule].

scenarios.question: When should a burglary claim be referred to SIU?
scenarios.answer:
A burglary claim should be referred to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) when 3 or more red flags are present. Red flags include no signs of forced entry, sum insured increased within the last 6 months, claim within 90 days of policy start, high-value items without receipts, inconsistent police report, and previous similar claims. The policyholder must not be informed about the referral. Additionally, a fraud score above 70 also triggers an SIU investigation. A score between 50 and 70 requires senior handler review before settlement [KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#referral-rule, KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#red-flags-for-staged-burglary, KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#fraud-score-thresholds].

productionPath: Identity: replace development personas with Microsoft Entra ID sign-in (Microsoft.Identity.Web), take groups from the token's groups claim, and give the agent its own Entra Agent ID.

Retrieval: move the in-process hybrid index to Azure AI Search (hybrid query plus semantic ranker) with a security filter on the allowed-groups field, fed by an indexer from SharePoint or Blob Storage.

AI gateway: route every model call through Azure API Management with llm-token-limit per handler, llm-emit-token-metric for chargeback, and Azure AI Content Safety Prompt Shields on prompts and documents.
Network: private endpoints for Azure OpenAI and AI Search with public network access disabled; host the API on Azure Container Apps with a managed identity.
Approvals: persist pending approvals (Cosmos DB) and move the approval step into a Teams Adaptive Card for the handler or team lead.
Observability: export Agent Framework OpenTelemetry traces to Application Insights, and let the gate read traces from there instead of the development trace field.
CI: run this gate on every pull request that changes prompts, models, tools or the index (Azure Pipelines build validation with workload identity federation, no stored secrets).
Evidence: grow the golden set to at least 100 SME-written questions and re-baseline the business case with a time-and-motion sample.
